name: comp-328

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows every field filled, including the detected card brand icon.

tagline: Card update modal takes number, expiry and CVC and shows the card brand.
summary: A trigger opens a dark dialog to replace a saved card: name, card number with brand detection, expiry and CVC side by side, a default-payment checkbox and an Update card button.
appearance: Closed, an outlined Card details button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a wallet icon, a bold Update your card title and grey line, a Name on card field, a Card Number field with a small card icon at the right, Expiry date and CVC side by side, a muted checkbox line and a white full-width Update card.
behaviour: Opening focuses the first field. Typing a card number formats it and swaps the generic card glyph for the brand mark; the expiry also formats as you type. Update card does nothing, and the X or Escape closes.
demo_content: Filled example uses Maya Chen, card 4242 4242 4242 4242 and expiry 12 / 28.
use_when: A signed-in user needs to replace or update their saved card in a quick modal.
avoid_when: It depends on a third-party card-input library and offers no submit or validation feedback.
customise: Labels, checkbox text and button label are fixed in the file; number and expiry formatting come from the card-input library.
weight_why: One dialog and four inputs; the card library only formats entered values.

a11y.note: Card fields are labelled and the brand icon hidden, but Update card has no handler or validation feedback.

issues: Update card has no handler, so the card is never saved.
The card brand glyph is decorative but only the generic icon carries aria-hidden.
polish_why: Tidy payment form with automatic card branding; the inert submit is the only flaw.
title: Card Details Dialog
